readout_other: fiber photometry of GRABDA2m dopamine sensor in nucleus accumbens; ED1 and GFAP immunohistochemistry; Evans Blue BBB opening for targeting
direction_notes: Stimulation of the VTA at 10% duty cycle and 2.5 s sonication produced a significant post-stimulation increase in nucleus accumbens dopamine versus sham; 2.5% and 5% duty cycles produced no significant increase.
safety_notes: Superficial cortical damage from the skull screws fixing the chip was seen; no inflammation or tissue damage at the VTA target; temperature rise of the device below 1 C at 10% duty cycle (about 6 C at 50%) in bench testing.

exposures.label: epidural eFUS to VTA (parameter sets p1-p5 analysed in detail)

device.model: eFUS device (CMOS ASIC with integrated 2D PZT array)

timing.protocol_description: Twelve parameter sets were tested; five (p1 to p5) analysed in detail all at PRF 1 kHz with DC 2.5, 5, 10, 20, 50% and SD 10, 5, 2.5, 1, 0.5 s. Each trial had a 30 s baseline, a sonication, and an inter-stimulus interval of at least 45 s, repeated 3 times per site.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Four male Sprague Dawley rats (Janvier Labs, France), aged 12 weeks were used in the study.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The eFUS chips utilized in this study were designed for a fundamental frequency of 4 MHz, but individual characterization showed peak pressures varying between 3.7 and 4.0 MHz.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: The parameters varied in pulse width (PW; 25 µs to 80.000 µs), pulse repetition frequency (PRF; 0.0025 kHz to 1.5 kHz), and duty cycle (DC; 2.5% to 50%), while the voltage was kept constant at 20 V and the peak pressure ranged between 0.26 and 0.574 MPa.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: Five parameter combinations (p1, PRF 1kHz, DC 2.5%, SD 10s; p2, PRF 1kHz, DC 5%, SD 5.0s; p3, PRF 1kHz, DC 10%, SD 2.5s; p4, PRF 1kHz, DC 20%, SD 1.0s; p5, PRF 1kHz, DC 50%, SD 0.5s) have been selected for detailed analysis.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Five parameter combinations (p1, PRF 1kHz, DC 2.5%, SD 10s; p2, PRF 1kHz, DC 5%, SD 5.0s; p3, PRF 1kHz, DC 10%, SD 2.5s; p4, PRF 1kHz, DC 20%, SD 1.0s; p5, PRF 1kHz, DC 50%, SD 0.5s) have been selected for detailed analysis.

flags.reason: Four rats stated; one was excluded for misalignment and two further animals were used separately for BBB-opening targeting checks
0.26 to 0.574 MPa is stated for all in vivo sets; intro says peak focal pressures were derived assuming 0.8 dB/cm/MHz brain attenuation from water measurements, so the domain is inferred as derated
Water-tank pressures are shown only as derated estimates or in figures; no free-field value for the in vivo exposures is given in the main text
Pulse width '25 µs to 80.000 µs' (European decimal separator, taken as 80 ms) is the range across all twelve sets, not only p1-p5
PRF 0.0025 to 1.5 kHz across twelve sets; p1-p5 all at 1 kHz
Designed 4 MHz; individual devices peaked between 3.7 and 4.0 MHz
Paper states there was no correction for a possible auditory confounder
